orca: Snapmaker Orca 2.4.1, isolated profile (--datadir plus redirected user directories), loading only; nothing sliced, no printer contacted
subject: examples/demo_u1_showcase.3mf as shipped in v1.7.0, sha256 7d0daae0c663a56919e79cf30f24c16b9cfcc163f311c7cf4d804d0d5d88f665
method: Copies of the shipped file with only the named parts changed were opened one at a time in a fresh isolated Orca process; the real user profile hashes were identical before and after every run; one run per variant.

variants.name: v0_current
variants.observed: Snapmaker Orca error: Loading of model file failed.

variants.name: v1_pkg_only
variants.changes: [Content_Types].xml and _rels/.rels replaced with minimal real parts (rels and model content types; a relationship to /3D/3dmodel.model)
variants.observed: No load error. Orca shows its Customized Preset prompt for the file's foreign printer settings; the automation stopped there, so full plate loading was not confirmed.

variants.name: v2_settings_only
variants.changes: Metadata/model_settings.config reduced to the one object the model contains; empty package stubs kept
variants.observed: Snapmaker Orca error: Loading of model file failed.

variants.name: v3_both
variants.observed: No load error; Customized Preset prompt (same as v1_pkg_only).

variants.name: v4_fixed_sample
variants.changes: the corrected fixture (only [Content_Types].xml and _rels/.rels differ from the shipped file; all other parts byte-identical)
variants.observed: No load error; Customized Preset prompt (same as v1_pkg_only).

conclusion: With the empty [Content_Types].xml and _rels/.rels stubs Orca 2.4.1 refuses the file; with real parts that load error does not appear (the runs stopped at Orca's preset prompt, so later loading stages were not exercised), whether or not the extra model_settings objects are kept. The two stubs were changed together, so the cause is pinned to that pair, not to either alone. The shipped v1.7.0 file is unchanged; a corrected file is follow-up work.
